passages.provision_quote: First— That Section 7.5 of Article I thereof is repealed. Second— That Section 7.5 is added to Article I thereof, to read: SEC. 7.5. (a) The right to marry is a fundamental right.
passages.note: Chaptered text of the same record; it prints the operative provision but names no actor, so actor and tally fields are null here.

rows.reasoning: Wiener carried ACA 5 (2023-2024) on the Senate floor ("ACA5 Low et al. By Wiener") and voted for it; the measure repeals the constitutional provision limiting marriage and adds "The right to marry is a fundamental right." A measure that secures the right to marry and carries no anti-discrimination clause matches "Guarantee same-sex marriage the same benefits and protections as any other marriage" and not the rung that adds "protection from discrimination (such as in jobs and housing)". Every recorded tally on the bill shows no votes against, so his bare Aye would be near-unanimous; the chair rests on his carrying the measure together with the chair-shaped provision.
